_doc: Three new L3-COUNTRY rows for finance/model/country-reference.json covering the ABC cluster (Aruba / Curacao / Bonaire). Schema mirrors the existing French Polynesia row (closest analog: high-cost, import-dependent, diesel-island-with-wind). Splice these into countries{} during the model cascade. Country keys must match the 'country' field the ABC corridors will carry.
_capex_note: CAPEX is NOT in this file (this is opex/cost_index only). Per Jaideep 24-Jun, the Caribbean CAPEX tier = $900K/vessel (treated like US/EU, NOT the $600K tier). Set this in the CAPEX-region logic (aggregate.py / vessel-constants.json) when wiring the abc-islands market.
_energy_source: Dutch govt 'Renewable Energy Future for the Dutch Caribbean Islands' (officielebekendmakingen.nl): ABC electricity US$0.35-0.38/kWh despite subsidies. Aruba (WEB/Vader Piet wind), Curacao (Aqualectra/Tera Kora + Playa Kanoa wind), Bonaire (ContourGlobal diesel + high wind share) all carry meaningful wind, moderating an otherwise fuel-oil/diesel grid (Shirley & Kammen: ABC wind LCOE < $0.03/kWh, high capacity factors).

captain_usd_yr.source: Modeled. Dutch-Caribbean tourism economy (GDP/cap ~$30k); AWG pegged to USD. Blended 1 commercial tourism-boat captain + deckhand fully-loaded ~$40k/vessel/yr. Above Latin America, below French Polynesia's French-territory social charges ($55k).

energy_usd_kwh.source: Dutch govt report: ABC commercial electricity US$0.35-0.38/kWh despite subsidies. WEB Aruba fuel-oil + Vader Piet wind. Anchored $0.35.

grid_co2_kg_kwh.source: Fuel-oil/diesel base moderated by ~15-20% Vader Piet wind. Anchored 0.58 (below pure diesel ~0.70); upgradeable with WEB Aruba official factor.

marina_overhead_usd_yr.source: Modeled berth+insurance+admin/vessel/yr. Renaissance Marina / Palm Beach premium island ops; ~= French Polynesia $18k.

cost_index.source: Relative to Singapore=1.00. High USD-pegged import economy + high energy ($0.35 = 1.67x SG) but no French social charges. Blended ~0.80, just below French Polynesia 0.90.

captain_usd_yr.source: Modeled. ANG pegged to USD; tourism+refinery economy. Blended captain+deckhand ~$40k/vessel/yr, ~= Aruba.

energy_usd_kwh.source: Dutch govt report $0.35-0.38/kWh. Aqualectra fuel-oil + Tera Kora/Playa Kanoa wind; Aqualectra raising renewable share. Anchored $0.35.

grid_co2_kg_kwh.source: Fuel-oil base + wind parks. Anchored 0.60; upgradeable with Aqualectra official factor.

marina_overhead_usd_yr.source: Modeled. Spanish Water (Caracasbaai) + Willemstad premium island ops.

cost_index.source: Relative to Singapore=1.00. ~= Aruba; slightly lower general price level. Blended ~0.78.

captain_usd_yr.source: Modeled. Special municipality of the Netherlands; uses USD. Smaller dive-led economy; blended captain+deckhand ~$38k/vessel/yr, just below Aruba/Curacao.

energy_usd_kwh.source: Dutch govt report $0.35-0.38/kWh; ACM-NL regulated. ContourGlobal diesel + high wind share. Anchored $0.35.

grid_co2_kg_kwh.source: Bonaire historically among the highest Caribbean wind penetration (~30-40%), moderating its diesel base more than Aruba/Curacao. Anchored 0.50; upgradeable.

marina_overhead_usd_yr.source: Modeled. Kralendijk + dive-resort jetties; smaller-scale than Aruba/Curacao premium marinas.

cost_index.source: Relative to Singapore=1.00. USD economy, high energy, high import logistics (small island). Blended ~0.80.
